name: Forest Stalker
lore: Proposition originale de La Longue Chasse d’après le brief partiel récupéré ; aucun statut canonique revendiqué.

assets.label: Forest Stalker — corps, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create an original Yautja-inspired creature or vehicle design for the 2D fan-game La Longue Chasse. Not a canonical franchise replica. Exactly TWO complete side-profile views arranged SIDE BY SIDE, two columns ONE ROW, left view faces RIGHT and right view faces LEFT. Separately draw the opposite side of the SAME design at identical scale and anatomy. Flat PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background. No shadows, scenery, text, watermark, panels, grid, ground or effects. Both full silhouettes entirely inside their own half with generous blank margins and no parts crossing the center gutter. Detailed hand-painted production bitmap for horizontal side-scrolling play. No people, rider, cargo, mounted weapon, trophy or detachable saddle baked in. Keep body and attachments separable. An ORIGINAL arboreal alien riding animal, lean sinewy quadruped with EXACTLY FOUR limbs, long flexible tail fully visible, narrow reptile-feline head without Yautja mandibles, huge curved climbing claws, textured dark olive hide with discreet bark-like dorsal plates. Strong shoulders, supple torso, long rear legs, far limbs visibly offset so anatomy is countable. Long tail curves gently behind but never crosses frame or overlaps other view. Standing relaxed side-on. NO saddle, harness, armor, chains, rider or tack: naked animal base layer. Predatory but plausible musculature, nonhuman skull and body; not an Earth panther reskin or xenomorph.
notes: Vue d’identité et non animation. Anatomie, raccords et modules à valider avant intégration.
